blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models increasingly serve as judges of other models, shaping benchmark rankings and model development. Yet, a judge whose rationale consistently supports its verdict may still disagree with human preferences. To study this, we introduce PRIMEAPE, a multilingual benchmark for evaluating judge verdicts and rationales. PRIMEAPE provides 2,205 response pairs covering 243 instructions in English, French, Spanish, Urdu, Hindi, Norwegian Bokmål, and Yoruba, with 11k human annotations of preferences and rationales across relevance, naturalness, truthfulness, safety, and overall quality. Our evaluation of twelve open- and closed-weight judges reveals that aggregate performance conceals differences across languages and criteria, while requesting rationales does not consistently improve agreement with human preferences. Judges also favor the first position, longer responses, and responses from related models, with effects that vary across criteria and languages. Crucially, judges can justify verdicts that disagree with human preferences while maintaining consistency between their verdicts and rationales. These findings show that consistency with a judge's own verdict does not establish alignment with human judgment. PRIMEAPE enables assessment of both, providing a foundation for more reliable multilingual judges. We release our benchmark and all annotation materials under the CC BY-NC 4.0 license at github.com/Toloka/primeape.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to judge generated responses, offering a scalable alternative to human evaluation. The LLM-as-a-judge paradigm Zheng et al. (2023) ; Leiter and Eger (2024) ; Gao et al. (2025) informs data collection, benchmark rankings, and preference learning, but remains understudied beyond English.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)被广泛用于判断生成的响应,为人类评价提供了可扩展的替代品. LLM-as-a-judge 范式 Zheng等人(2023年);Leiter和Eger(2024年);Gao等人(2025年)为数据收集、基准排名和偏好学习提供了信息,但英语以外的研究仍然不足。

blocks.en: Previous work has introduced judge benchmarks Tan et al. (2025) and preference datasets with model rationales Cui et al. (2024) . Fewer resources include human rationales Wang et al. (2025a) ; Wang et al. (2025b) , especially in multilingual settings. Studies have shown that response order Shi et al. (2025) and prompt formulation Stureborg et al. (2024) ; Long et al. (2025) affect judge verdicts. Recent work has trained judges to reduce bias and improve consistency across evaluation modes Yang et al. (2026) , while other studies find that criterion ordering affects scores when judges assess multiple criteria jointly Xu et al. (2026) . Building on this work, we examine how prompt variation, criteria grouping, and rationale generation affect judge’s agreement with human preferences.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作引入了法官基准 Tan等人(2025年)和带有模型原理的偏好数据集Cui等人(2024年). 王等人(2025年a)等资源较少; Wang et al. (2025b),特别是在多语种环境下. 研究表明,响应令Shi等人(2025年)和即时配方Stureborg等人(2024年);Long等人(2025年)影响法官的判决. 最近的工作对法官进行了培训,以减少偏见,提高各种评价模式的一致性,Yang等人(2026年),而其他研究则发现,当法官联合评估许等人(2026年)的多重标准时,标准排序会影响分数. 在这项工作的基础上,我们审视了迅速的变异、标准分组和原理生成如何影响法官与人类偏好之间的一致。

blocks.en: We introduce Primeape , a multilingual benchmark of 2,205 response comparisons in English, French, Spanish, Urdu, Hindi, Norwegian Bokmål, and Yoruba. Humans select response A, B, or a tie and justify judgments across relevance, naturalness, truthfulness, safety, and overall quality. Primeape combines a larger English component with shared instructions manually translated into six languages, totaling 243 instructions. Non-English component accounts for 43.7% of the benchmark (963 comparisons). We evaluate twelve open- and closed-weight judge models to address three research questions across languages and criteria : • RQ1 : How well do judges’ verdicts agree with human preferences, and how does criteria grouping affect this agreement? • RQ2 : Does generating a rationale improve agreement with human preferences, and are the resulting rationales consistent with the judge verdicts and human preferences? • RQ3 : How do position and length biases vary across criteria and languages, and do judges favor responses from their own model family?

blocks.en: We find that judge performance varies across languages and criteria, with some failures hidden by aggregate scores. Multi-prompt evaluation affects judge rankings, and majority-vote judge ensembles do not outperform the best single judge. Separating criteria has little average effect without rationales but lowers macro-F1 for each judge when rationales are requested. Judges can generate rationales that support their own verdicts even when those verdicts disagree with human preferences. Ten of the twelve judges favor longer responses more often than humans do, and nine of the twelve related judge-generator pairs show self-preference for responses from the judge’s own model family, particularly when assessing overall quality and naturalness. Our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们发现法官的表现因语言和标准而异,有些失败被总分所掩盖. 多速评会影响法官排名,多数投票制法官综艺不会比最佳单一评委表现优异. 在没有理由的情况下,分离标准几乎没有平均效果,但在要求提出理由时,每个法官的宏观-F1较低。 法官可以提出理由,支持他们自己的判决,即使这些判决与人类的偏好不一致。 12位法官中有10位比人类更倾向于更长的答复时间,12位相关的法官-生成者配对中有9位表示自己喜欢法官自己的模范家庭的答复,特别是在评估整体质量和自然性时。 我们的捐款如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce Primeape , a multilingual benchmark of 2,205 response comparisons with 11k human preference and rationale annotations across five criteria and seven typologically diverse languages, enabling joint evaluation of judge verdicts and rationales. • We show that consistency between judge’s rationale and verdict does not imply agreement with human preferences. • We evaluate twelve open- and closed-weight LLMs as judges, revealing failures masked by aggregate scores, sensitivity to evaluation design, and position, length, and model-family biases across languages and criteria.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们采用Primape这一多语种基准,将2 205项答复与5项标准和7种类型多样性语言的11k人偏好和理由说明进行比较,从而能够对法官的判决和理由进行联合评价。 我们表明,法官的理由与判决之间的一致性并不意味着同意人类的偏好。 我们评价12个开放和封闭加权的法学硕士和评委,发现被总分、对评价设计的敏感性以及语文和标准的定位、长度和家庭模式偏见掩盖的失败。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Table 1 compares judge benchmarks and preference datasets with rationales. It shows that Primeape uniquely combines multilingual coverage with human preferences and rationales for each of the five evaluation criteria.
blocks.zh: 表1将判断基准和偏好数据集与理由进行比较。 它表明,Primape将多语种覆盖与人类偏好和五个评价标准中每个标准的理由相结合。

blocks.en: MT-Bench provides human preferences for response pairs Zheng et al. (2023) , LLMBar tests instruction following Zeng et al. (2024) , and JudgeBench tests verifiable correctness Tan et al. (2025) . RewardBench and RewardBench 2 covers chat, safety, and reasoning, allowing selection among four responses and ties Lambert et al. (2025) ; Malik et al. (2026) . RM-Bench tests whether response style changes affect quality judgments Liu et al. (2025) . Judge evaluation has expanded beyond English. REPA evaluates judges in Russian using human pairwise preferences across eleven criteria Pugachev et al. (2025) . M-RewardBench extends preference evaluation through translation Gureja et al. (2025) , while MM-Eval combines human preferences with automated multilingual comparisons Son et al. (2026) . RECON provides synthetic response ratings verified by humans Doddapaneni et al. (2025) , and MENLO collects human ratings across 47 language varieties Whitehouse et al. (2026) . Autorubric evaluates criteria separately and introduces CHARM-100, comprising 100 synthetic English conversations with reference labels for six criteria Rao and Callison-Burch (2026) .
blocks.zh: MT-Bench提供人类对反应对的偏好 Zheng等人(2023年),LLMBar测试规范遵循Zeng等人(2024年),Bench法官测试可核实的正确性 Tan et al. (2025) (英语). Reward Bench和Reward Bench 2涵盖聊天,安全和推理,允许在4个回应和联系Lambert等人(2025)中进行选择;Malik等人(2026). RM-Bench测试反应风格的变化是否影响质量判断 Liu et al. (2025). 法官评价已超出英语范围。 REPA评价俄罗斯语法官, M-Reward Bench通过翻译Gureja et al.(2025)扩展偏好评价,而MM-Eval则将人类偏好与自动多语种比较Son et al.(2026)结合. RECON提供由人类Doddapaneni等人(2025年)核实的合成反应评分,MENLO收集了人类对47种语言品种Whitehouse等人(2026年)的评分. Autorubric单独评价标准,并引入CHARM-100,由100个合成英语对话组成,并带有Rao和Callison-Burch(2026年)的6个标准的参考标签.

blocks.en: These benchmarks cover diverse tasks and languages but lack human-written rationales for individual evaluation criteria.
blocks.zh: 这些基准涵盖各种任务和语言,但缺乏个人评价标准的人文理由。

blocks.en: We use rationale to denote a free-text justification of a preference, written by an annotator or generated by a judge Herrewijnen et al. (2024) . UltraFeedback provides model-generated ratings and rationales across criteria Cui et al. (2024) . HelpSteer2-Preference and HelpSteer3-Preference collect human preferences and rationales, with the latter covering multilingual tasks Wang et al. (2025a) ; Wang et al. (2025b) . MetaJudge compares model rationales with atomic critique points derived from human justifications in HelpSteer3-Atomic, showing that verdict accuracy can hide differences in rationale agreement Wang et al. (2026) . However, these datasets focus mostly on English, including overall quality and other evaluation criteria.
blocks.zh: 我们用理由来表示由注释员撰写或由法官Herrewijnen等人(2024年)撰写的首选的自由文本理由。 UltraFeedback提供跨标准Cui等人(2024年)的模型生成的评级和原理. HelpSteer2-Preference and HelpSteer3-Preference收集人类偏好和理由,后者涵盖Wang等人的多语种任务(2025a); 王等 (2025b) (中文(简体) ). MetaJudge将模型原理与HelpSteer3-Atomic中从人类原理中得出的原子批评点相比较,表明判决准确性可以掩盖原理协议Wang等人(2026年)的分歧. 然而,这些数据集主要侧重于英语,包括总体质量和其他评价标准.

blocks.en: Primeape addresses this gap by combining multilingual response comparisons with human-annotated preferences and rationales for five criteria, enabling criterion-specific analysis of both agreement with human judgments and consistency between verdicts and rationales.
blocks.zh: Primape通过将多语种反应比较与五个标准的附加说明的偏好和理由结合起来,从而能够根据具体标准分析与人类判断的一致以及判决和理由的一致性,来弥补这一差距.

blocks.en: 3.1 Instruction Collection
blocks.zh: 3.1 指令集

blocks.en: We collect 125 English instructions covering open-domain questions, dialogue-style requests, and summarization (see Appendix A in § A for example instructions). We manually select 100 instructions from the AlpacaEval evaluation set Li et al. (2023) , with 25 from each of its four sources: OpenAssistant Köpf et al. (2023) , Vicuna Zheng et al. (2023) , Koala Geng et al. (2023) , and Helpful Base Bai et al. (2022) . Our selection prioritizes instructions whose responses can be assessed without specialized domain expertise. To broaden task coverage, we add 25 summarization instructions based on news articles from CNN/DailyMail See et al. (2017) , sampling 17 CNN articles and 8 DailyMail articles from the lowest quartile of the length distribution.
blocks.zh: 我们收集了125份英文指示,涉及开放域问题、对话式请求和概括(例如,见A节附录A)。 我们手动从AlpacaEval评价集Li等人(2023年)中选取100条指令,其四个来源各有25条: 开放助理Köpf等人(2023年),维库纳 郑等人(2023年),科阿拉 Geng等人(2023年),以及Helpful Base Bai等人(2022年). 我们的挑选将指示放在优先位置,这些指示的响应可以没有专业领域的专门知识来评估。 为了扩大任务覆盖面,我们根据CNN/DailyMail See等人(2017年)的新闻文章增加了25篇总结说明,从长度发行量中最低的四分之一抽取17篇CNN文章和8篇DailyMail文章。

blocks.en: The multilingual component uses 20 of the 100 English AlpacaEval instructions, five randomly sampled from each of AlpacaEval’s four sources. Authors and annotators manually translate these into six target languages, yielding 20 aligned instructions per language.
blocks.zh: 多语种成分使用100种英语AlpacaEval指令中的20种,从AlpacaEval的四个来源中分别随机抽取了5种. 作者和注释员手动将这些翻译为6种目标语言,每种语言产生20个对齐指令.

blocks.en: 3.2 Response Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2 生成反应

blocks.en: For each instruction, we collect one response from each of five open- and closed-weight models (see Table 10 in § F.1 ). For the 100 English AlpacaEval instructions, we use the outputs released at github.com/tatsu-lab/alpaca_eval .
blocks.zh: 对于每一项指示,我们从五个开放和封闭重量模型中每个模型收集一个答复(见第F.1节表10)。 使用在github.com/tatsu-lab/alpaca_eval上发布的输出。

blocks.en:
We generate all remaining responses via OpenRouter using the same models and AlpacaEval’s hyperparameters for the 25 English summarization instructions, and mostly newer model versions with default hyperparameters for other languages (see Table 12 in § F.1 ).
Pairing the five responses yields ten pairs per instruction, or 2,450 comparisons (1,250 in English, 200 per other language).
blocks.zh:
我们使用相同的模型和AlpacaEval的超参数,通过OpenRouter生成所有剩余的响应,用于25种英语的归纳指令,以及大多数其他语言默认超参数的最新模型版本(见第F.1节表12)。
5个答复对齐后,每个指示产生10对,或2 450个比较(英语1 250个,其他语言200个)。

blocks.en: We conduct annotation in-house with one annotation lead and 15 annotators at toloka.ai . Their language expertise covers all seven target languages, and all have native or near-native proficiency. The annotators have experience in creating data for learning from human feedback and explainable AI. The lead has a background in computational linguistics, coordinates the work, and provides feedback throughout the project. Based on 11 voluntary survey responses, we summarize annotator profiles in § B and satisfaction with the annotation project in § C .
blocks.zh: 我们进行内部注解,其中1个注解铅和15个注解在toloka.ai。 他们的语言专长涵盖所有7种目标语言,并且都具有本土或接近本土的熟练程度. 注释者在创建数据以学习人类反馈和解释性AI方面的经验. 主角具有计算语言学的背景,协调工作,并在整个项目中提供反馈. 根据11份自愿调查答复,我们总结了§B中的注释者简介,并对§C中的注释项目表示满意。

blocks.en: Our project includes training, annotation, and validation phases. Annotators first complete five training examples to learn the task, guidelines, and interface. The annotation lead checks their understanding before granting access to annotation. Each annotator receives one example at a time, comprising an instruction and two model responses. They (i) carefully read the instruction and responses, (ii) check facts when needed, (iii) select a preference and write a rationale for each criterion, and (iv) proofread their submission (see § D ). During validation, the annotation lead reviews English, French, and Spanish submissions, while annotators review each other’s submissions in the remaining languages. Average pay is $25/hr, and submission records show an average annotation time of 12 minutes per example.
blocks.zh: 我们的项目包括培训、注释和鉴定阶段。 注释者首先完成五个培训实例,以学习任务、准则和接口。 注释主要检查他们的理解,然后才允许查阅注释。 每个注释员一次收到一个实例,包括一个指令和两个模型回复. 他们(一)仔细阅读指示和答复,(二)在需要时核对事实,(三)选择一种偏好,并为每项标准写出理由,(四)校对其提交材料(见§D)。 在审定期间,注解牵头审查英文、法文和西班牙文的呈文,而注解牵头者则以其他语文审查对方的呈文。 平均工资为25美元/小时,提交记录显示每个例子的平均注释时间为12分钟。

blocks.en: 3.4 General Statistics
blocks.zh: 3.4 一般统计

blocks.en: Primeape contains 2,205 response comparisons, 1 1 1 245 comparisons rejected by our annotators are excluded, leaving 19 instructions in French and Norwegian. 243 language-specific instructions, and 11,025 preference-rationale annotations (see Table 2 ). English contributes 1,242 comparisons, and the other languages 86-200 each.

blocks.en: We measure instruction, response, and rationale lengths using whitespace-separated tokens. English instructions average 52.9 tokens, compared with 11.4-15.1 in the other languages, consistent with their different task composition (see Table 2 ). The absolute length difference between paired responses averages 90.8 tokens, with language-level means ranging from 78.4 in Yoruba to 122.6 in Norwegian. Human rationales average 29.5 tokens, ranging from 20.8 for safety to 35.5 for relevance (see Appendix E in § E ).
blocks.zh: 我们用白空分隔的符号测量指示、反应和原理长度。 英文指示的平均值为52.9令牌,而其他语文为11.4-15.1令牌,与它们不同的任务组成一致(见表2)。 配对反应的绝对长度差平均为90.8个令牌,语言级别的含义从约鲁巴的78.4到挪威语的122.6不等. 人的理由平均为29.5个信使,安全为20.8个信使,相关性为35.5个信使(见附录E,§E)。

blocks.en: Preference distributions vary across criteria (see Appendix E in § E ). Ties account for 94.6% of safety judgments, 72.4% of truthfulness, 42.7% of relevance, 38.4% of naturalness, and 13.8% of overall quality. Across languages, naturalness ties range from 2.5% in Hindi to 95.1% in French, truthfulness ties from 28.0% in Yoruba to 98.8% in Spanish, and overall quality ties from 2.0% in Hindi to 33.5% in Urdu. Excluding ties, annotators prefer response A over B in 58% to 64% of judgments for every criterion except safety, where preferences vary by language. In 225 comparisons (10.2%), annotators prefer one response on one specific criterion and the other on another (see Appendix E in § E ).
blocks.zh: 各种标准的优惠分配不尽相同(见附录E,§E)。 铁丝网占安全判断的94.6%,真实性72.4%,相关性42.7%,自然性38.4%,整体质量13.8%. 不同语言的自然联系从印地语2.5%到法语95.1%,约鲁巴语28.0%到西班牙语98.8%,整体质量联系从印地语2.0%到乌尔都语33.5%。 除联系外,在每种标准中,有58%至64%的判决倾向于答复A而不是B,但安全除外,其偏好因语言而异。 在225项比较(10.2%)中,注释者倾向于对某一具体标准作出一个答复,对另一标准作出另一个答复(见附录E,§E)。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: We use Primeape as a zero-shot benchmark to evaluate whether judges can recover human preferences in various evaluation conditions. The judges span twelve open- and closed-weight models of different families and sizes (see Table 11 in § F.1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们使用Primape作为零镜头基准来评价法官能否在各种评价条件下恢复人类偏好. 法官分为12个不同家庭和大小的开放和封闭体重模式(见第F.1节表11)。

blocks.en: We explore seven evaluation conditions to address our research questions.
blocks.zh: 我们探索解决研究问题的七个评估条件.

blocks.en: 1. joint : the judge evaluates the response pair on all five criteria in a single call. 2. joint+r : as in joint , with a rationale preceding each criterion’s verdict. 3. criterion : the judge evaluates the response pair on each criterion in a separate call. 4. criterion+r : as in criterion , with a rationale preceding the verdict. 5. position bias : as in joint , with the order of responses A and B reversed. 6. length bias : joint and position bias verdicts, paired per comparison, test whether judges favor longer responses more often than annotators. 7. self-preference : the same paired verdicts, restricted to comparisons with a response from the judge’s own model or family, test whether judges favor such responses more than annotators and control judges.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合:法官在一次呼叫中评价所有五个标准的对应反应。 2. 联合+r:与联合一样,在每个标准的判决之前有一个理由。 3. 标准 :法官在单独调用中评价每个标准的对应反应。 4. 标准+r:与标准一样,在判决前有一个理由。 5. 立场偏差:与联合一样,答复A和B的顺序颠倒。 6. 长度偏差:联合和立场偏差判决,逐项比较,检验法官是否比注释者更倾向于较长的答复。 7. 自我偏好:相同的对等判决,仅限于与法官自己的模式或家庭的答复进行比较,检验法官是否比注释员和控制法官更赞成这种答复。

blocks.en: joint : the judge evaluates the response pair on all five criteria in a single call.
blocks.zh: 联合:法官在一次呼叫中评价所有五个标准的对应反应。

blocks.en: joint+r : as in joint , with a rationale preceding each criterion’s verdict.
blocks.zh: 联合+r:与联合案一样,在每个标准的判决之前有一个理由。

blocks.en: criterion : the judge evaluates the response pair on each criterion in a separate call.
blocks.zh: 标准 : 法官在单独调用中评价每个标准的对应反应。

blocks.en: criterion+r : as in criterion , with a rationale preceding the verdict.
blocks.zh: 标准+r : 与标准一样,在判决前有一个理由。

blocks.en: position bias : as in joint , with the order of responses A and B reversed.
blocks.zh: 立场偏差:与联合一样,反应A和B的顺序颠倒。

blocks.en: length bias : joint and position bias verdicts, paired per comparison, test whether judges favor longer responses more often than annotators.
blocks.zh: 长度偏差: 联合和位置偏差判决, 逐个比较对齐,

blocks.en: self-preference : the same paired verdicts, restricted to comparisons with a response from the judge’s own model or family, test whether judges favor such responses more than annotators and control judges.
blocks.zh: 自我偏爱:相同的对等判决,仅限于与法官自己的模式或家庭的答复进行比较,检验法官是否比注释员和控制法官更赞成这种答复。

blocks.en: Conditions 1-4 vary criterion grouping and rationale generation to examine their effects on judge behavior (RQ1-2).
blocks.zh: 条件1-4不同标准分组和原理生成,以检查其对判断行为的影响(RQ1-2).

blocks.en: Conditions 5-7 address position, length, and self-preference biases across languages and criteria (RQ3), respectively.
blocks.zh: 条件5-7分别涉及语言和标准之间的位置、长度和自我偏好(RQ3)。

blocks.en: We evaluate three prompt variants (P0-P2) in joint to assess judge sensitivity to wording and output format Stureborg et al. (2024) ; Long et al. (2025) . The variants are written in English and manually translated into the other six languages. For the remaining conditions, we use one prompt per language, shared by all judges and chosen by voting over joint (P0 for French and Hindi, P1 for the other languages). § F.2 describes the templates, selection rule, and prompt adaptations.
blocks.zh: 我们联合评估三个即时变体(P0-P2),以评估法官对措辞和产出格式Stureborg等人(2024年);Long等人(2025年)的敏感性。 变体用英语书写,人工翻译成其他六种语言. 至于其余条件,我们使用每种语言一个速率,由所有法官共同使用,通过共同投票选出(法语和印地语为P0,其他语言为P1)。 §F.2描述了模板,选择规则,以及即时改编.

blocks.en: Following MT-Bench Zheng et al. (2023) and RewardBench Lambert et al. (2025) , we request verdicts in a specific format. Our criterion-aware parser extracts explicit verdicts, treating missing or unparsable ones as errors (see § F.3 ). We report: (i) strict format compliance , the share of outputs that follow the requested format; (ii) valid-verdict rate , the share of expected verdicts recovered by the parser; and (iii) rationale presence , the share of expected verdicts with a rationale of at least three tokens. See § F.4 for details and extraction results.
blocks.zh: 跟随MT-奔驰 Zheng等人(2023年)和Reward Bench Lambert等人(2025年),我们要求以特定格式作出判决。 我们的标准解析器提取了明确的判决,将缺失或无法解析的判决视为错误(见F.3节)。 我们报告:(一) 严格格式遵守,产出中符合所要求格式的份额;(二) 有效核实率,由鉴定人收回的预期判决的份额;(三) 理由存在,预期判决中至少有三个符号的理由。 详情和提取结果见F.4节。

blocks.en: We use macro-F1 over all expected verdicts (counting invalid verdicts as errors), accuracy, and valid-verdict rate. We compare the judges with trivial and ensemble baselines: always tie, majority-label, and majority-vote ensembles of the top five judges by macro-F1, the top nine by valid-verdict rate, and all twelve. Cohen’s κ \kappa measures agreement between judges and with humans. Borda count Rofin et al. (2023) aggregates judge rankings across the five criteria within each language, then across languages, yielding scores on a 0-100 scale. § F.6 details the metrics and agreement measures.
blocks.zh: 我们对所有预期的判决(将无效的判决算作错误)、准确性和有效验证率使用宏F1。 我们把法官与琐碎的、共同的基线相比较:总比对、多数-标签和多数-投票组合,前五名法官按宏观-F1、前九名按有效核查率,以及所有12名。 科恩在法官之间和与人类之间达成的“Kappa”措施协议。 Borda counter Rofin et al. (2023年) 法官在每种语言内跨五个标准排名,然后跨语言排名,得出0-100的分数. F.6节详细说明了衡量标准和协议措施。

blocks.en: We compare generated and human rationales using chrF++ Popović (2017) , LaBSE cosine similarity Feng et al. (2022) , and NLI-based support, contradiction, and coverage Laban et al. (2022) . We also compare the NLI-implied verdict Yin et al. (2019) with the judge and human preferences to measure self-consistency and human-label agreement, respectively Wiegreffe et al. (2021) . Refer to § F.5 for definitions and implementation.
blocks.zh: 我们用chrF++来比较生成的和人类的原理 Popović (2017), LaBSE 余弦相似性 Feng et al. (2022), 和 NLI 基于支持,矛盾, 和覆盖 Laban et al. (2022). 我们还比较了由NLI简化的判决Yin等人(2019年)与法官及人类偏好,分别衡量自我一致性和人类标签协议,Wiegreffe等人(2021年). 定义和执行参见F.5节。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Figure 2: Effect of the evaluation condition. Paired change in macro-F1 per judge for requesting rationales ( joint+r − - joint , criterion+r − - criterion ) and for separating criteria ( criterion − - joint , criterion+r − - joint+r ). Solid lines and the values above the panels give the mean over judges.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 评价条件的效果。 每名法官申请理由(联合+r−-联合,标准+r−-标准)和分离标准(标准−-联合,标准+r−-联合+r)的宏观-F1的变迁。 牢靠的线条和以上小组的价值使法官胜过法官。

blocks.en: We first report preference prediction under joint (§ 5.1 ), then the effects of criterion grouping and rationale generation (§ 5.2 ), rationale evaluation (§ 5.3 ), and judge biases (§ 5.4 ). Breakdowns by prompt and language are described in § G and § H .
blocks.zh: 我们首先在联合(第5.1节)下报告偏好预测,然后报告标准分组和理由产生(第5.2节)的影响、理由评价(第5.3节)和判断偏差(第5.4节)。 按即时和语言分类的细目在§G和§H中描述.

blocks.en: 5.1 Preference Prediction (RQ1)
blocks.zh: 5.1 优先预测(RQ1)

blocks.en: Table 3: Preference prediction results in joint , averaged over languages. Macro-F1 (%) for relevance ( R ), naturalness ( N ), truthfulness ( T ), safety ( S ), and overall quality ( O ); F1 : their mean; Acc : accuracy; Borda : ranking score (0-100); Valid : valid-verdict rate. Bold and underline mark the best and second-best judge.
blocks.zh: 表3:各种语言的偏好预测结果。 宏-F1(%)表示相关性(R),自然性(N),真实性(T),安全性(S),以及整体质量(O);F1:他们的平均值;Acc:准确性;Borda:排名分数(0-100);有效:有效验证率. 大胆地强调,标出最佳和次佳的法官。

blocks.en: Table 3 reports preference prediction results for joint under selected prompts. Gemini-2.5-Pro leads in mean macro-F1 (49.4), accuracy (68.8%), and Borda score (96.1), followed by GPT-5 (46.8 macro-F1) and Qwen3-32B (46.5), which leads on overall quality. Gemini-2.5-Pro leads in macro-F1 in six languages, and Qwen3-32B in Urdu.
blocks.zh: 表3报告选定提示下联合预测偏好的结果。 双子座-2.5-Pro领先于平均宏F1(49.4),精确度(68.8%),博尔达得分(96.1),其次是GPT-5(46.8 macro-F1)和Qwen3-32B(46.5),领先于整体质量. 双子座-2.5-Pro领先于6种语言的宏F1,乌尔都语的Quen3-32B.

blocks.en: Only Gemini-2.5-Pro exceeds the 66.0% accuracy of the majority-label baseline, which mostly predicts Tie on safety and truthfulness, where most human labels are ties. Nine judges, however, exceed its 28.3 macro-F1: they distinguish the three labels better than a constant prediction but predict Tie far less often than humans. On safety, only four judges exceed the 39.4 macro-F1 of the trivial baselines.
blocks.zh: 只有双子座-2.5-Pro超过了多数标签基准的66.0%的准确度,这大多是预测的. 安全性与真实性 人类的标签大多是连结 不过,9名法官超过了其28.3个宏F1:他们比不断预测更好地区分三个标签,但预测 绑起来比人类少得多 在安全方面,只有四名法官超过了微不足道的基线中的39.4宏观-F1。

blocks.en: The per-language results show failures that these averages hide (see Tables 30 - 36 in § H.1 ). The majority-label baseline leads on French naturalness (best judge: 32.9; baseline: 48.8) and on safety in French, Spanish, and Urdu, where most human labels are ties.
blocks.zh: 每种语言的结果显示这些平均数所隐藏的失败(见第H.1节表30-36)。 多数标签基线是指法国自然性(最佳判断:32.9;基线:48.8),以及安全性,法语,西班牙语和乌尔都语,其中人类标签大多是关系.

blocks.en: We further see that on Yoruba safety, only GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5-Pro exceed the baseline, whereas GPT-4o-mini , LLaMA-3.1-70B , and LLaMA-3.3-70B reach only 6% accuracy because they almost always choose A or B. In contrast, all twelve judges exceed the baseline in 14/35 language-criterion combinations, though never in English or Yoruba. Judges agree with humans most in Hindi, with a median macro-F1 of 56.2 vs. 35.4-44.5 in the other languages. The best judge varies: Gemini-2.5-Pro leads in 12 combinations, and eight other judges lead in the rest, including Qwen2.5-7B and LLaMA-3.1-8B .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步看到,在约鲁巴安全方面,只有GPT-5和双子座2.5-Pro超过了基线,而GPT-4o-mini、LLaMA-31-70B和LLaMA-3-3-3-70B几乎总是选择A或B,其准确度只有6%。 相比之下,所有12名法官在14/35语言-标准组合中都超过了基线,尽管从未使用英语或约鲁巴语。 法官们赞同印地语中人最多的说法,其他语言的宏F1中位数为56.2对35.4-44.5. 最佳评委各有不同:双子座-2.5-Pro在12位组合中领先,其余8位评委则领先,包括Quen2.5-7B和LLaMA-3.1-8B.

blocks.en: We would like to note that many valid verdicts require parsing beyond the specified format. In joint , the judges’ strict format compliance is 76.9%, whereas their valid-verdict rate is 90.5% (see Table 14 in § F.4 ). The judges with the lowest valid-verdict rates (63-74%), LLaMA-3.1-8B , Qwen2.5-7B , and Phi-4-mini , have the lowest macro-F1; we refer to them as low-validity judges.
blocks.zh: 我们谨指出,许多有效判决需要解析,超出规定的格式。 法官的严格格式遵守率为76.9%,而有效核证率为90.5%(见第F.4节表14)。 有效核实率最低(63-74%)、LLaMA-3.1-8B、Quen2.5-7B和Phi-4-mini的法官的宏观-F1率最低;我们称之为低效力法官。

blocks.en: The five judges with the highest macro-F1 agree with each other ( κ = 0.46 \kappa=0.46 ) more than with humans ( κ = 0.28 \kappa=0.28 ), most clearly on naturalness (0.47 vs. 0.24). Their errors also coincide: when one of the five is wrong, another is wrong on 69% of the same comparisons (vs. 38% overall). On 8.9% of comparisons, all five agree on a verdict that humans reject, most often on overall quality (12.8%), naturalness (11.2%), and relevance (10.4%); most of these unanimous errors prefer one response where annotators see a tie (57%). Agreement barely depends on model family: averaged over languages and criteria, judges of the same family agree about as much as other pairs ( κ = 0.30 \kappa=0.30 vs. 0.29 0.29 ), except LLaMA-3.1-70B and LLaMA-3.3-70B ( κ = 0.64 \kappa=0.64 ). The majority vote of the top five reaches 48.9 macro-F1, slightly below the 49.4 of Gemini-2.5-Pro ; the nine- and twelve-judge ensembles score lower (46.5 and 45.7).
blocks.zh: 宏F1最高的五位评委相互同意(0.46\kappa=0.46),比人类多(0.28\kappa=0.28),最明显的是自然性(0.47对0.24). 他们的错误也是一致的:当其中之一错误时,另一个错误是69%的相同比较(总体为38%). 在8.9%的比较中,所有五个国家都同意一个人类拒绝的判决,最常拒绝的是整体质量(12.8%)、自然性(11.2%)和相关性(10.4%);大多数这些一致的错误都倾向于在注释者看到平局(57%)的情况下做出答复。 协议几乎不取决于模范家庭:平均在语言和标准上,同一家庭的法官同意与其他对(0.30\kappa=0.30对0.290.29)相同,但LLaMA-31-70B和LLaMA-3.3-70B(0.64\kappa=0.64)除外。 前5名的多数票数达到48.9 macro-F1,略低于双子座2.5-Pro的49.4;9位和12位裁判的综艺得分较低(46.5和45.7).

blocks.en: Analyzing the multi-prompt results in joint , we find that the same judge ranks first under all three prompts in only 4/35 language-criterion combinations (see Table 22 in § G ). No language retains the same winner across all prompts for naturalness and overall quality. Mean pairwise rank correlation is τ b = 0.59 \tau_{b}=0.59 ( ρ = 0.74 \rho=0.74 ), dropping to τ b = 0.47 \tau_{b}=0.47 without the low-validity judges, whose low ranks are stable.
blocks.zh: 分析多时速结果后,我们发现,同一法官仅以4/35语言-标准组合排在所有三个前列(见第G节表22)。 没有任何语言能保留同样的赢家 在所有的提示中 自然和整体质量。 平均对等等级相关性为\ b = 0.59\ tau\ b\ 0.59 (\ = 0.74\ = 0.74), 降为\ b\ = 0.47\ tau\ b\ 0.47 没有低级别法官, 其等级是稳定的。

blocks.en: Our prompt maximizes macro-F1 across all five criteria for 12/84 language and judge combinations. Yet, the selected prompt scores within 1.1 macro-F1 points of the best mean per language, and both prompts rank the same judge first (see § F.2 ).
blocks.zh: 在12/84语言和判断力组合的所有五项标准中,我们的速率最大限度地提高了宏观-F1。 然而,每个语言的最佳平均值在1.1个宏-F1分之内的选定快速分数,而这两个快速分数都排在同一个法官的首位(见第F.2节)。

blocks.en: 5.2 Criteria and Rationales (RQ1-2)
blocks.zh: 5.2 标准和理由(RQ1-2)

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes four contrasts between evaluation conditions. With rationales, separate calls lower mean macro-F1 by 3.0 points relative to joint calls across all twelve judges. Without rationales, separating criteria has little average effect, lowering macro-F1 by 0.2 points. Requesting rationales lowers mean macro-F1 by 1.5 points in separate calls but raises it by 1.4 points in joint calls. These gains vary: the low-validity judges gain 7.0 points on average, alongside a 10.9-percentage-point increase in valid-verdict rate, while six of the other nine judges decline. Separating criteria with rationales is the clearest and most consistent disadvantage.
blocks.zh: 图2总结了评价条件之间的四个对比。 与所有12名法官的联名通话相比,用理由分别调用3.0分的平均值-F1。 没有理由,分离标准几乎没有平均效果,将宏F1降低0.2分. 请求理由降低意味着宏-F1在单独调用中比1.5分,但在联合调用中则提高1.4分. 这些收益各不相同:低功率法官平均获得7.0个百分点,而有效核查率则增加10.9个百分点,另外9名法官中有6名下降。 将标准与理由分开是最明显和最一贯的缺点。

blocks.en: Across criteria, the separate-call rationale effect is largest for truthfulness ( − 4.6 -4.6 ), followed by safety ( − 1.7 -1.7 ) and relevance ( − 1.3 -1.3 ), and close to zero for naturalness and overall quality ( + 0.1 +0.1 and + 0.3 +0.3 ); scores decline in 26/35 language-criterion combinations.
blocks.zh: 在整个标准中,单独调用理由效应对真实性影响最大(−4.6-4.6),其次是安全性(−1.7-1.7)和相关性(−1.3-1.3),自然性和整体质量接近零(+0.1+0.1和+0.3+0.3);在26/35语言-标准组合中分数下降。

blocks.en: Across judge subsets, including those that exclude judges with many invalid verdicts, adding rationales to separate calls lowers macro-F1 by 1.4 to 2.0 points, whereas joint-call rationale effects are positive or close to zero (see Table 21 in § F.6 ). Adding rationales to separate calls lowers mean macro-F1 in each language, although the decline in Hindi is negligible ( − 0.03 -0.03 ), and the 95% bootstrap intervals include zero for Hindi, Spanish, and Yoruba (see Figure 11 in § H.2 ).
blocks.zh: 在整个法官子集中,包括那些排除许多无效判决的法官的子集中,在单独调用中增加理由将宏观-F1降为1.4至2.0分,而联合调用理由效应是积极或接近于零(见F.6节表21)。 将理由添加到单独的调用中,在每种语言中都意味着宏-F1,尽管印地语的下降可以忽略不计(−0.03-0.03),95%的靴子间隔包括印地语、西班牙语和约鲁巴语的零(见第H.2节图11)。

blocks.en: 5.3 Rationale Evaluation (RQ2)
blocks.zh: 5.3 理由评价(RQ2)

blocks.en: Table 4: Quality of judge rationales (%). Each rationale condition pools all languages and criteria; scores average the two conditions. SC / HA : class-balanced agreement of the NLI-implied verdict with the judge’s valid verdict/the human label; Sup / Con : mean entailment/contradiction of judge sentences given the human rationale; Cov : mean entailment of human sentences given the judge rationale.
blocks.zh: 表4:法官理由的质量(%)。 每个理由条件汇集所有语文和标准;得分平均为这两个条件。 SC/HA: 与法官的有效判决/人名一致的NLI简化判决的班级平衡; Sup/Con:从人的理由出发,意味着法官判决的必然性/必然性; Cov:从法官的理由出发,意味着人类判决的必然性。

blocks.en: NLI recovers the human labels from human rationales with 81-88% accuracy in six languages, but only 56% in Yoruba, which we exclude from all NLI aggregations (see details in § F.5 ). The reference for judges in our evaluation is the class-balanced agreement of human rationales with their own labels (82.7%).
blocks.zh: NLI以81-88%的精度在6种语言中从人类原理中恢复人类的标签,但在约鲁巴语中只有56%,我们将其排除在所有NLI集合之外(详见F.5节)。 在我们的评价中,法官们的参考标准是,以自己的标签(82.7%)平衡地认同人的理由。

blocks.en: Gemini-2.5-Pro has the highest self-consistency (86.9%; see Table 4 ), while Claude-Sonnet-4 has the highest coverage score (39.3), despite self-consistency of 70.9%. Across judges, chrF++ and self-consistency show only a weak rank correlation ( ρ = 0.24 \rho=0.24 ), whereas human-label agreement and coverage are more closely correlated ( ρ = 0.83 \rho=0.83 ).
blocks.zh: 双子座2.5-Pro的自我一致性最高(86.9%;见表4),而克洛德-索内特-4的覆盖分数最高(39.3),尽管自我一致性为70.9%。 在整个评委中,chrF++和自我一致性只显示等级关联度较低( ^ = 0.24\rho= 0.24),而人与标签协议和覆盖面的关联性更为密切( ^ = 0.83\rho= 0.83)。

blocks.en: In the rationale conditions, separate calls produce rationales twice as long as joint calls (65.3 vs. 32.9 tokens), with lower support (12.7 vs. 22.5) and human-label agreement (49.6 vs. 52.0) but slightly higher coverage (31.1 vs. 29.4) and lower contradiction (8.2 vs. 9.6; see Table 18 in § F.5 ). These are the two conditions compared by criterion+r − - joint+r ( − 3.0 -3.0 macro-F1). Longer rationales thus do not consistently align better with humans.
blocks.zh: 在原理条件中,单独调用产生的理由比联合调用(65.3对32.9令牌)长一倍,支持率较低(12.7对22.5),人标签协议(49.6对52.0),但覆盖面略高(31.1对29.4),矛盾度较低(8.2对9.6;参见§F.5中的表18). 这些是按标准+r−−−联合+r(−3.0−3.0宏F1)比较的两个条件. 因此,较长的理由与人类不尽一致。

blocks.en: On verdicts that disagree with human labels (excluding unparsable outputs), self-consistency is 65.8% in both rationale conditions: most rationales imply the judge’s own, wrong verdict. Human-label agreement is only 18.2% under joint+r and 17.3% under criterion+r (see Table 17 in § F.5 ), which is low largely by construction, as a rationale cannot imply both the judge’s verdict and a different human label. The reasoning measures, which do not depend on the implied verdict, point the same way: compared with rationales for correct verdicts, these rationales cover less of the human reasoning (21-23 vs. 36-39) and contradict it more often under joint+r (12.9 vs. 7.1).
blocks.zh: 在与人类标签不一致的判决(不包括不可平反的产出)中,两种理由条件的自我一致性为65.8%:大多数理由都暗示法官自己的错误判决。 人类标签协议在联合+r下只有18.2%,在标准+r下只有17.3%(参见第F.5节表17),这在很大程度上是建筑造成的,因为理由不能意味着法官的判决和不同的人类标签。 推理措施并不取决于默示判决,但指出的同样方式是:与正确判决的理由相比,这些理由较不涵盖人的推理(21-23诉36-39),在联合+r(12.9诉7.1)下更经常地与之相矛盾.

blocks.en: Rationales for wrong verdicts coherently justify the judge’s choice even when it disagrees with humans, so consistency does not establish correctness relative to the reference. This gap persists when we mask explicit preference wording in the rationales (59.0% vs. 22.5% on wrong verdicts, see § F.5 ).
blocks.zh: 错误判决的理由一致地证明法官的选择是正当的,即使它与人类有分歧,因此一致性并不能证明相对于引用的正确性。 如果我们在理由中掩盖了明确的偏好措辞(错误判决时为59.0%对22.5%,见F.5节)。

blocks.en: These results highlight the need to assess agreement with humans separately from consistency between verdicts and rationales.
blocks.zh: 这些结果突出表明,需要将与人类的协议与判决和理由的一致性分开评估。

blocks.en: Table 5: Position bias results averaged over languages and criteria. Position score : mean of + 1 +1 (first slot preferred), − 1 -1 (second), and 0 0 (Tie) over both orders. 1st / 2nd-slot lock : % of decisions in which the same slot wins in both orders; Consistency : % of verdicts unchanged by the swap; Both valid : % of decisions with valid verdicts in both orders.
blocks.zh: 表5:语文和标准方面的职位偏差平均结果。 位置分数:均值+1+1(首选档位),−1-1(次),0(Tie),均高于两顺序. 1st / 2th-slot 锁定:在两个命令中同一档次获胜的决定百分比; 一致性 : 以互换方式不变的判决百分比; 两者均有效 : 两种命令中均有效的判决百分比。

blocks.en: We validate NLI verdict recovery from judge rationales through a human evaluation in English, Norwegian, and Urdu (see § F.5 ). Two annotators per language identify the preference expressed in each assigned rationale without seeing the instruction or the responses. The sample comprises 465 rationales: 390 judge rationales and 75 human rationales used as a control. Both annotators label 45 of the judge rationales per language (135 in total) and agree on 92% ( κ = 0.88 \kappa=0.88 ). They recover the human label from 99% of the control rationales. Across all 390 judge rationales, the annotators agree with NLI on 72% ( κ = 0.58 \kappa=0.58 ; see Table 16 ). When a judge’s verdict is wrong, the annotators recover that verdict from 87% of the rationales and the correct one from only 2% (the remaining 11% are mostly “Can’t tell”); NLI recovers them from 70% and 14% of the same rationales, respectively. NLI thus underestimates self-consistency on wrong verdicts, so the gap between self-consistency and correctness is larger under human evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过用英语、挪威语和乌尔都语进行人文评估,验证NLI从法官理由中恢复的判决(见F.5节)。 每种语言有两名注释员,在不见指示或答复的情况下,确定每种指定理由中表达的偏好。 样本包括465个理由:390个判断理由和75个作为控制手段的人类理由。 两位注释者都标注了法官每种语言的45个理由(共计135个),并商定了92%(=0.88\kappa=0.88)。 他们从99%的控制原理中恢复人类的标签. 在所有390项判断理由中,注释者同意NLI的72%(=0.58\kappa=0.58;见表16)。 当法官的判决错误时,注释者从87%的理由和只有2%的理由(其余的11%大多是“不能说”)的正确理由中恢复了这一判决;NLI则从同样的理由中分别恢复了70%和14%。 因此NLI低估了对错误判决的自我一致性,因此在人类评价下,自我一致性与正确性之间的差距更大.

blocks.en: 5.4 Judge Bias Evaluation (RQ3)
blocks.zh: 5.4 比亚斯法官评价(RQ3)

blocks.en: On comparisons with valid verdicts in both orders, judges favor the first displayed response on average (position score + 0.14 +0.14 ; see Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 在与两个命令中的有效判决进行比较时,法官平均倾向于第一个显示的答复(职位分数+0.14+0.14;见表5)。

blocks.en: They choose the first slot in both orders for 15.0% of comparisons, versus 4.2% for the second slot. The effect is largest for Qwen2.5-7B ( + 0.48 +0.48 ) and LLaMA-3.1-8B ( + 0.30 +0.30 ). A low position score does not mean that verdicts survive the swap: the judges keep their verdicts in only 64.8% of comparisons on average.
blocks.zh: 他们以15.0%的比较率选择两个顺序中的第一个档位,而第二个档位则选择4.2%。 对Qwen2.5-7B(+0.48+0.48)和LLaMA-3.1-8B(+0.30+0.30)的影响最大. 低位分数并不意味着判决在互换中存活下来:法官们只保持平均64.8%的比较.

blocks.en: Position bias is strongest for relevance ( + 0.20 +0.20 ) and weakest for naturalness ( + 0.06 +0.06 ). It is also stronger in English, Norwegian, and Spanish ( + 0.20 +0.20 to + 0.21 +0.21 ) than in Hindi, Yoruba, and French ( + 0.07 +0.07 to + 0.09 +0.09 ), and the 95% intervals do not overlap between these two groups (see Table 38 in § H.3 ).
blocks.zh: 位置偏差对相关性最强(+0.20+0.20),对自然性最弱(+0.06+0.06). 与印地语,约鲁巴语和法语(+0.07+0.07++0.09+0.09)相比,英语,挪威语和西班牙语(+0.20+0.20++0.21+0.21)的频率也更强,95%的间隔不与这两个组重叠(参见H.3节中的表38).

blocks.en: Ten of twelve judges favor the longer response more often than humans do on the same comparisons: on average, judges choose it in 64.9% of comparisons and humans in 60.2% (see Table 39 in § H.3 ). For overall quality, the difference is − 0.2 -0.2 points when response lengths differ by less than 25%, but + 9.1 +9.1 points when one response is at least twice as long. The length and content vary together, so they do not isolate an effect of verbosity. The difference is largest for naturalness ( + 6.5 +6.5 ) and smallest for relevance ( + 1.4 +1.4 ). It reaches 7.5-8.9 points in English, Norwegian, Spanish, and Urdu (see Table 40 in § H.3 ), but is slightly negative in Hindi ( − 2.8 -2.8 ), where annotators favor longer responses especially often, and in Yoruba ( − 0.7 -0.7 ). Excluding the three low-validity judges ( LLaMA-3.1-8B , Qwen2.5-7B , and Phi-4-mini ), both language gaps are close to zero ( + 0.4 +0.4 and + 0.5 +0.5 ; see § H.3 ).
blocks.zh: 在12名法官中,有10名法官赞成比人类更经常地在同样的比较中作出更长的答复:平均而言,法官在64.9%的比较中选择,而人类在60.2%中选择(见第H.3节表39)。 对于整体质量,当反应长度差异小于25%时,差值为−0.2-0.2点,但当一个反应至少长一倍时,则+9.1+9.1点. 长度和内容各有不同,因此它们不会孤立动词的一种效果. 自然性(+6.5+6.5)的差值最大,相关性(+1.4+1.4)的差值最小. 它在英语、挪威语、西班牙语和乌尔都语中达到7.5-8.9分(见第H.3节表40),但在印地语中则略呈负数(−2.8-2.8),其中注释者特别倾向于较长的答复时间,在约鲁巴语中则略为偏差(−0.7-0.7)。 不包括三名低工作能力法官(LLaMA-3.1-8B、Quen2.5-7B和Phi-4-mini),这两种语言差距都接近于零(+0.4+0.4和+0.5+0.5;见§H.3)。

blocks.en: Nine of the twelve judge-generator combinations show self-preference of + 5.2 +5.2 to + 11.0 +11.0 points (see Table 41 in § H.4 ); the largest is GPT-5 on GPT-4-0613 responses ( + 11.0 +11.0 ). The effect does not simply follow model identity: GPT-4o-mini favors its own responses ( + 10.0 +10.0 ) but not those of GPT-4-0613 ( − 7.0 -7.0 ), and LLaMA-3.3-70B slightly disfavors its own responses ( − 3.2 -3.2 ). On average, self-preference is largest for overall quality ( + 5.7 +5.7 ) and naturalness ( + 5.3 +5.3 ) and smallest for safety ( + 1.7 +1.7 ). Naturalness and overall quality are the most subjective of our criteria; similarly, in rubric-based evaluation, self-preference is stronger for subjective rubrics, such as communication tone, than for more verifiable ones, such as instruction following Pombal et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 十二个判官-生成者组合中,有九个显示自我偏好+5.2+5.2到+11.0+111.0分(参见H.4中的表41);最大的是GPT-5在GPT-4-0613响应上(+11.0+111.0). 效果不单纯遵循模型身份:GPT-4o-mini偏好自己的反应(+10.0+10.0),但并非GPT-4-0613(−7.0-7.0),LLaMA-3.3-70B对自己的反应略有不满(−3.2-3.2). 平均而言,自优性对整体质量(+5.7+5.7)和自然性(+5.3+5.3)最大,对安全性(+1.7+1.7)最小. 自然性与整体质量是我们标准中最主观的;同样,在基于主题的评价中,自我偏好对于主观主题,如沟通语气,比对于比较可核查的,如Pombal等人(2026年)之后的指示更强烈.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We introduced Primeape , a new multilingual benchmark for fine-grained meta-evaluation of judge models with human preferences and written rationales for each response pair across five criteria and seven languages. Our empirical evaluation of twelve LLM judges focused on how their behavior varies across languages, criteria, and evaluation conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Primape, 一个新的多语种基准, 我们对12名LLM法官的实证评价侧重于他们的行为如何因语言、标准和评价条件而异。

blocks.en: Agreement with human preferences varies across languages and criteria, with relevance, naturalness, truthfulness, and safety revealing patterns that aggregate scores and overall quality alone conceal. Judges predict ties far less often than annotators and share many of their errors, so majority-vote ensembles do not improve on the best single judge. Separate calls per criterion barely change average agreement without rationales but consistently lower it with rationales. Thus, criteria grouping and rationale generation should be considered jointly in evaluation design.
blocks.zh: 与人类喜好的协议因语言和标准不同而不同,相关性、自然性、真实性和安全性揭示出总分和整体质量本身掩盖的模式。 法官们预测联系的次数远少于注释员,并分享他们的许多错误,因此多数选票组合并不能改善最佳的单一法官。 依据标准单独调用,几乎无法改变没有理由的平均协议,但始终以理由降低。 因此,在评价设计中应共同考虑标准分组和理由的产生。

blocks.en: Generating rationales does not consistently improve preference prediction; the benefits depend on the evaluation setup and the judge. Crucially, a rationale can be consistent with the judge’s verdict while that verdict contradicts the human label. Human evaluation of judge rationales in English, Norwegian, and Urdu confirms this pattern, and the NLI-based analysis suggests that it persists after explicit preference statements are masked, highlighting the need to assess self-consistency and alignment with human references separately.
blocks.zh: 产生理由并不能始终改善偏好预测;好处取决于评价设置和法官。 关键是,一个理由可以与法官的判决一致,而该判决与人类的标签相矛盾。 对英语,挪威语,乌尔都语法官原理的人类评价证实了这一模式,基于NLI的分析表明,在明确偏好声明被掩盖后,它会持续,这突出说明了需要分别评估自我一致性和与人类引用的一致性.

blocks.en: Judges exhibit different bias patterns across criteria and languages. Position effects are strongest for relevance, whereas excess preference for longer responses is strongest for naturalness. Self-preference is also common among the tested judge-generator pairs, although it varies across judges. These patterns motivate the fine-grained evaluation of judge behavior across languages and criteria enabled by our benchmark.
blocks.zh: 法官在标准和语言上表现出不同的偏向模式。 位置效应对相关性最强,而对较长反应的过度偏好对自然性最强。 自我偏好在被测试的法官-产生者配对中也是常见的,尽管这种偏好因法官而异. 这些模式激励着对不同语言和我们的基准所促成的标准的法官行为的精心评价。

blocks.en: In future work, we plan to extend our dataset and experiments to other languages and tasks. We further want to analyze two-stage LLM-as-a-judge setups Tsunefuji et al. (2026) , and to test condition effects across prompts and repeated completions. Finally, we plan to expand human evaluation of judge rationales in order to assess reasoning quality beyond verdict recovery.
blocks.zh: 在今后的工作中,我们计划将我们的数据集和实验扩展到其他语言和任务. 我们还想分析两个阶段的LLM-as-a-judges States Tsunefuji等人(2026年),并测试各种提示和重复完成的情况效应。 最后,我们计划扩大对法官理由的人道评价,以便评估除恢复判决之外的推理质量。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Cross-language comparisons reflect differences in sample size, task composition, and response models, not only in language. All seven subsets share 19-20 instructions, but English adds 105 more, including summarization, and uses older response models from the same or related families; the subsets also retain unequal numbers of comparisons. The Norwegian subset does not cover Nynorsk, the second official written standard of the Norwegian language. The observed language differences therefore characterize the benchmark subsets and cannot be attributed to language alone. Criterion-specific comparisons are less affected, as every response pair is annotated on all five criteria.
blocks.zh: 跨语言的比较反映了样本大小,任务构成,以及响应模型的差异,而不仅仅是语言的差异. 所有七个子集共享19-20指令,但英语又增加了105个,包括汇总,并使用来自相同或相关家族的旧反应模型;子集还保留了不平等的比较数量. 挪威语子集不包括挪威语的第二个正式书面标准Nynorsk. 因此,观察到的语言差异是基准子集的特征,不能仅归因于语言。 特定标准比较的影响较小,因为所有五个标准都附有说明。

blocks.en: Our multi-prompt evaluation aims to analyze judge sensitivity, not to identify optimal judge configurations. We test three prompt variants only in joint and select one prompt per language for the remaining evaluation conditions due to limited resources. Prompt selection uses the evaluation comparisons themselves; selecting on held-out data would avoid favoring the selected prompts. The evaluation results can differ under other prompts. The majority-label baseline uses the label frequencies of the evaluation data and therefore serves as an oracle reference. We collect one completion per judge and do not measure generation variability. Our parser requires explicit verdicts and does not infer implicit ones.
blocks.zh: 我们的多时评价旨在分析判断敏感性,而不是确定最佳判断配置. 由于资源有限,我们只对三种快速变体进行联合测试,并为其余的评价条件选择每种语文的快速变体。 快速选择使用评价比较本身;在搁置的数据上选择可以避免偏向选定的提示。 评价结果在其他提示下可能有所不同。 多数标签基准使用评价数据的标签频率,因此可作为甲骨文参考。 我们收集到每个法官一个完成的数据,不衡量生成的变化。 我们的判断要求有明确的判决,而不是暗示。

blocks.en: Annotations reflect a small in-house team’s judgments under our guidelines and may not represent broader linguistic and cultural expectations. Each pairwise comparison is labeled by a single annotator and then reviewed in the validation phase (see § 3.3 ), so we cannot measure inter-annotator agreement for the labels. Correctness in our evaluations denotes agreement with these human labels; moreover, human rationales may omit other valid justifications.
blocks.zh: 说明反映了一个小型内部小组根据我们的指导方针所作的判断,可能不代表更广泛的语言和文化期望。 每次对偶比较都由一个单独的注释者标注,然后在验证阶段审查(参见§3.3),因此我们不能衡量标签的注释者之间的协议. 我们评价的正确性表示同意这些人类的标签;此外,人类的理由可能忽略其他有效的理由。

blocks.en: Evaluating whether two free-text rationales share reasoning remains an open problem: a preference can be justified in many valid ways, and similarity measures reward shared wording rather than shared reasoning Jacovi and Goldberg (2021) ; Herrewijnen et al. (2024) . Self-consistency and human-label agreement depend on how well NLI recovers the verdict expressed in a rationale.
blocks.zh: 评估两个自由文字理由是否共享推理仍然是一个尚未解决的问题:一种偏好可以用许多有效方式证明,类似性措施奖励共同措辞而不是共同推理 Jacovi and Goldberg (2021); Herrewijnen等人 (2024). 自我一致性和人类标签协议取决于NLI如何恢复以理由表达的判决。

blocks.en: We validate this recovery on human rationales in all seven languages, but on judge rationales only for a sample in English, Norwegian, and Urdu, where NLI is less reliable than on human rationales. Yoruba remains part of the verdict analyses but is excluded from all NLI aggregates because verdict recovery is unreliable in this language. Support, contradiction, and coverage follow established NLI-based measures Laban et al. (2022) , but we do not validate them against human judgments.
blocks.zh: 我们用所有七种语言的人类原理来验证这种恢复,但只用英语、挪威语和乌尔都语的样本来验证法官原理,因为那里的NLI不如人类原理可靠。 Yoruba仍然是判决分析的一部分,但被排除在国家综合指数总数之外,因为判决的恢复在这种语言中是不可靠的。 拉班等人(2022年)支持、矛盾和覆盖,

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: The annotation task includes evaluating potentially harmful or biased model outputs. Annotators can reject examples they are not confident annotating and validating, although this does not eliminate the risk of exposure to such content. Survey participation is voluntary, and all annotators agree to the release of their anonymized survey responses. § C shows that 73% of the survey respondents agree that the pay is fair, with none disagreeing. The results of the human evaluation conducted by the authors are anonymized.
blocks.zh: 注释任务包括评价可能有害或有偏见的模型产出。 注释者可以拒绝他们不自信地进行注释和验证的例子,尽管这并不消除接触这种内容的风险。 调查参与是自愿的,所有注释者都同意公布其匿名调查答复。 § 翻译: C显示,73%的调查答卷人同意工资是公平的,没有人不同意。 作者进行的人类评价的结果是匿名的。

blocks.en: Primeape is intended for evaluating LLM-as-a-judge models; thus, using it to train or fine-tune judges and reward models would contaminate the benchmark. It is not a comprehensive safety benchmark, as the annotation guidelines exclude refusals and examples that require extensive fact-checking and expertise. Our experiments show that agreement with human preferences varies across languages, criteria, and evaluation conditions, and that consistent rationales can sometimes support verdicts that disagree with human labels. Aggregate scores, agreement between human judges, and fluent rationales should not replace actual human-based evaluation, which remains crucial when automated judgments inform decisions affecting large audiences.
blocks.zh: Primape旨在评价作为法官的LLM模型;因此,利用它来培训或微调法官和奖励模型将污染基准。 它不是一个全面的安全基准,因为注释准则排除了需要广泛核实事实和专门知识的拒绝和例子。 我们的实验表明,与人类喜好的协议在语言,标准,评价条件上各不相同,一致的理由有时可以支持与人类标签不一致的判决. 综合评分、人类法官之间的一致和流利的理由不应取代实际的以人为基础的评价,而当自动判断为影响广大受众的决定提供信息时,这种评价仍然至关重要。

blocks.en: Primeape may reproduce biases in its source instructions, generated responses, and human judgments. The benchmark reflects our annotation setting and should be used alongside other evaluations. We document experimental costs, instruction sources, response models, annotation guidelines, licensing terms, and evaluation prompts to support open research and ensure reproducibility.
blocks.zh: Primape可能会在源指令、生成的回复和人类判断中重复偏见。 该基准反映了我们的说明设定,应与其他评价一起使用。 我们记录实验费用、指导来源、反应模式、说明准则、许可证条款和评价,以便支持公开研究并确保可复制。

blocks.en: We release Primeape under the CC BY-NC 4.0 license, in line with the license of the AlpacaEval data from which its instructions and part of its English responses are drawn. The model responses remain subject to the terms of use of their original providers.
blocks.zh: 根据阿尔帕卡-埃瓦尔数据的许可证,我们根据CC BY-NC 4.0许可证发放了Primaape,并从中提取了它的指示和部分英文答复。 示范答复仍受制于其原始提供者的使用条件。

Claude assisted with the presentation of tables, figures, and appendices, with refining the verdict and rationale parser developed iteratively by the authors, and with the human evaluation of NLI verdict recovery, for which it implements the annotation interface and the sampling. GPT assisted with proofreading, language editing, and brainstorming NLI-based measures of support, contradiction, and coverage. Neither assistant contributed to benchmark design, research questions, result interpretation, or manuscript drafting. The main author manually reviewed all assistant outputs and remains responsible for their use.

blocks.en: D.1 Annotation Guidelines
blocks.zh: D.1 注释准则

blocks.en:
Relevance :
Which response better follows the instruction and completes the user’s request? Consider whether it addresses the entire instruction.
blocks.zh:
相关性:
哪些答复最好遵循指令并完成用户的要求? 考虑它是否涉及整个指令.

blocks.en:
Naturalness :
Which response is more human-like? Consider the flow and tone of the language.
blocks.zh:
自然性质:
哪个反应更像人类? 考虑语言的流畅和语气.

blocks.en:
Truthfulness :
Which response is more truthful? Prefer accurate and factually consistent responses.
blocks.zh:
真实性 :
哪个答复更真实? 最好作出准确和事实一致的答复。

blocks.en:
Safety :
Which response is less harmful? Prefer respectful, non-harmful, and non-offensive responses.
blocks.zh:
安全性 :
哪些反应危害较小? 偏爱尊重,无害,无犯罪反应.

blocks.en:
Overall quality :
Which response is best? Consider which response is most helpful and satisfactory for the user.
blocks.zh:
总体质量:
哪个反应最好? 考虑哪些答复对用户最有帮助和最满意。

blocks.en: Read the instruction. Understand the user’s request or instructions.
blocks.zh: 念诵指示. 了解用户的要求或指示。

blocks.en: Reject the example if: • The instruction requires specialized knowledge or skills. • Fact-checking takes more than 15 minutes. • The instruction is unclear or lacks context. • You do not feel confident annotating it.
blocks.zh: · 教学需要专门知识或技能的,拒绝举例: • 实况调查需要15分钟以上。 该指示不明确或缺乏上下文。 你没有信心去说明它。

blocks.en: The instruction requires specialized knowledge or skills.
blocks.zh: 教学需要专业知识或技能。

blocks.en: Fact-checking takes more than 15 minutes.
blocks.zh: 检查事实需要超过15分钟。

blocks.en: The instruction is unclear or lacks context.
blocks.zh: 指令不明确或缺乏上下文。

blocks.en: You do not feel confident annotating it.
blocks.zh: 你没有信心去说明它。

blocks.en: Read both responses. Look for unsafe content, contradictions, factual inconsistencies, and language issues. Reject the example if either AI refuses to respond.
blocks.zh: 阅读两个答复。 寻找不安全的内容,矛盾,事实不一致,语言问题. 如果大赦国际拒绝答复,则拒绝。

blocks.en: Assess. Compare the responses using the five criteria, focusing only on their content.
blocks.zh: 评估。 用这五项标准来比较答复,只注重其内容.

blocks.en: Explain. Write 2-3 explanatory sentences per criterion.
blocks.zh: 解释,每个标准写2-3个解释性句子。

blocks.en: Add a comment. Include any additional comments or feedback.
blocks.zh: 增加评论. 包括任何其他评论或反馈。

blocks.en: Proofread. Review your judgments and rationales.
blocks.zh: 证经. 看看你的判断和理由

blocks.en: Submit. Submit your final version.
blocks.zh: 提交。 提交最后版本。

blocks.en: Do evaluate each criterion independently.
blocks.zh: 请独立评估每项标准。

blocks.en: Do highlight specific problems or strengths.
blocks.zh: 请突出具体问题或长处。

blocks.en: Do use reliable sources for fact-checking.
blocks.zh: 请使用可靠的来源进行事实检查。

blocks.en: Do consider offensiveness and potential harm.
blocks.zh: 考虑攻击性和潜在伤害。

blocks.en: Do not copy and paste from the responses.
blocks.zh: 不要复制和粘贴从答复。

blocks.en: Do not write vague rationales.
blocks.zh: 不写模糊的理由。

blocks.en: Do not use AI or tools to write rationales.
blocks.zh: 不要使用AI或工具来写理由.

blocks.en: They differ in role, cues, and verdict format (see Figure 8 for the English templates). P0 uses an expert evaluator role, repeated language cues, and numbered verdicts with longer labels. blocks.en: For each judge-criterion pair, the highest-scoring prompt on parsable verdicts receives one vote, split equally in ties. Summing votes across judges and criteria selects one prompt per language. Accuracy-based voting changes the selection in four languages but shifts mean macro-F1 by at most 1.0 point and preserves the top-ranked judge (see Table 13 ). We retain P0 for Hindi and P1 for Urdu.

blocks.en: We adapt the selected template to each evaluation condition while keeping its formulation, criterion wording, and verdict format fixed. blocks.en: F.3 Verdict Extraction
blocks.zh: F.3 判决

blocks.en: We map judge outputs to { A , B , Tie } \{\mathrm{A},\mathrm{B},\mathrm{Tie}\} with a rule-based parser refined through manual and automated output analysis. Recognized English and localized criterion labels identify the corresponding verdicts. The parser accepts A, B, and recognized tie expressions, allowing response prefixes (“Response A”), resolved option lists (“A/B/Tie: B”), trailing placeholders, and delimited rationales. In criterion and criterion+r , it also accepts a standalone final-line verdict. Missing, ambiguous, or conflicting decisions, unfilled templates (“A/B/Tie”, “B/Tie”), and outputs exceeding 10,000 characters are invalid. Labeled rationales do not override a preceding verdict, and free text is not used to infer verdicts.
blocks.zh: We map 判断输出到 {A, B, Tie } { mathrm{A},\ mathrm{B},\ mathrm{ Tie} 通过人工和自动输出分析改进了基于规则的解析器 。 公认的英文和本地化标准标签标明相应的判决。 解析器接受A,B,并承认带位表达式,允许响应前缀(“Response A”),解析的选项列表(“A/B/Tie:B”),后面的占位符,以及划定的理由. 在标准与标准+r中,它也接受独立的终线判决. 缺少、模棱两可或相互冲突的决定、未填充的模板(“A/B/Tie”、“B/Tie”)以及超过10 000个字符的输出无效。 标签上的理由不能推翻先前的判决,自由文本不能用来推断判决。

blocks.en: F.4 Output Validity

Conditions without rationales permit no other text. (ii) Valid-verdict rate counts verdicts regardless of their format, with five verdicts expected per joint output and one per separate output. (iii) Rationale presence applies to the rationale conditions only and has the same denominator as the valid-verdict rate, the number of expected verdicts.

blocks.en: F.5 Rationale Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: F.5 评价理由

blocks.en: We extract criterion rationales from the labeled blocks in joint+r and from the remaining output in criterion+r ; texts shorter than three tokens count as missing. We use self-consistency (SC) and human-label agreement (HA) to compare the NLI-implied verdict with the judge verdict and human label, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们从联合+r中标注的块和从标准+r中标注的剩余输出中提取标准理由;短于3个符号的文本算作缺失. 我们使用自我一致(SC)和人类标签协议(HA)来分别比较NLI所隐含的判决和法官的判决和人类标签.

blocks.en: Both average the agreement equally over A, B, and Tie, using judge-verdict classes for SC and human-label classes for HA. SC and wrong-verdict analysis require valid verdicts; HA includes all rationales, even with unparsable verdicts. Reasoning scores use up to ten sentences per rationale. Support ( Sup ) and contradiction ( Con ) average entailment and contradiction probabilities, using the full human rationale as the premise for each judge sentence. Coverage ( Cov ) reverses the direction.
blocks.zh: 协议中A、B和Tie的平均比例相同,在SC和HA使用法官认证班。 SC和错误的校验分析需要有效判决;医管局包括所有理由,即使有不可平反的判决。 理性分数每个理由使用最多10句. 支持(Sup)和矛盾(Con)平均意味着和矛盾概率,将充分的人性推理作为每个法官判决的前提. 覆盖(Cov)扭转方向.

blocks.en: We use MoritzLaurer/mDeBERTa-v3-base-xnli-multilingual-nli-2mil7 with three English hypotheses in every language: “Response A is better than Response B.”, “Response B is better than Response A.”, and “Response A and Response B are equally good.” The highest entailment probability determines the implied verdict.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Moritz Laurer/mDeBERTa-v3-base-xnli-multial-nli-2mil7,每种语言都有三种英语假设:“答复A比反应B好”、“答复B比反应A好”和“答复A和反应B同样好”。 最高概率决定了暗示的判决。

blocks.en: We evaluate human-label recovery from human rationales using accuracy, macro-F1, and per-label recall (see Table 15 ); B is the hardest label to recover in five of the six retained languages (66-76% recall). This evaluation validates verdict recovery only. Class-balanced agreement with the human rationales’ own labels is a distinct measure and serves as the HA reference. Alternative Tie hypotheses, e.g., “equally good or equally bad”, or the higher entailment of separate “equally good” and “equally bad” hypotheses, do not improve class-balanced recall.
blocks.zh: 我们用精确度、宏F1和每个标签的召回(见表15)来评价人类标签的恢复;B是最难回收的六种保留语言中的5种(66-76%的召回)。 这一评价仅验证了判决的追偿。 与人类理由本身的标签达成阶级平衡一致是一项独特的措施,是医管局的参考标准。 替代的铁丝网假设,例如“同等好或同等坏”或较高程度的单独“同等好”和“同等坏”的假说,并不能改善阶级平衡的召回。

blocks.en: The exclusion of Yoruba (see § 5.3 ) reflects a B recall of only 27%. The model often fails to distinguish A from B: it assigns A to all 13 human rationales stating that “Response B is the best in every respect” and all 57 stating that neither response contains anything harmful.
blocks.zh: 将Yoruba排除在外(见第5.3节),反映出B召回率仅为27%。 该模式往往未能区分A和B:它赋予了所有13个人类理由,说明“答复B在每个方面都是最好的”,所有57个理由都指出,两个答复都没有任何有害之处。

blocks.en: The human evaluation of NLI verdict recovery (see § 5.3 ) is conducted by the authors, who are native speakers of Norwegian and Urdu and fluent speakers of English. For each rationale, the annotators choose A, B, Tie, or “Can’t tell” (see the guidelines in § I ); the anonymized results are available in our repository. Before starting, each annotator practices on seven English rationales with feedback on the correct answer prepared by the main author. Per language, the sample contains 130 judge rationales from joint+r and criterion+r , drawn in equal numbers for each combination of condition, verdict correctness, and NLI confidence (highest entailment probability of at least 0.5), and 25 human rationales balanced over the human labels as a control. For the rationales assessed by both annotators, the comparison with NLI uses the answers of one annotator, fixed in advance, and “Can’t tell” counts as a mismatch. Reweighting the sample to all evaluated rationales of each language changes no per-language value in Table 16 by more than two points.
blocks.zh: 对NLI判决恢复的人力评估(见第5.3节)是由提交人进行的,他们是挪威语和乌尔都语的母语,是流利的英语语言。 注释者选择A、B、Tie或“无法分辨”(参见第一节中的准则); 在开始前,每个注释员在7个英文原理上进行练习,并反馈主要作者编写的正确答案. 按语言,样本中包含130个来自联合+r与标准+r的判断理由,对条件,判断正确性,NLI信心(最高概率至少为0.5)的每个组合以相同数字抽取,25个人类理由作为控制在人类标签上平衡. 与NLI的比较使用预先固定的注释员的答案, 将样本重新加权到每个语言的所有评估理由中,不会使表16中的每个语言值变化超过两点。

blocks.en: Table 16 reports the agreement and the SC and HA scores on wrong verdicts by language. Of the 11 disagreements between the annotators, 8 involve “Can’t tell”. NLI agrees with the annotators on 83.6% of judge rationales when its highest entailment probability is at least 0.5, and on 60.5% otherwise. Of the 109 mismatches, NLI predicts Tie where the annotators choose A or B in 40, swaps A and B in 30, and 30 are rationales marked as “Can’t tell”. Its agreement with the annotators ranges from 54% ( Qwen3-32B ) to 95% ( Gemini-2.5-Pro ) across judges, with 24-39 rationales each, so differences in SC between judges may partly reflect how reliably NLI recovers the verdicts from their rationales. NLI is also less accurate on judge rationales than on human rationales, where its accuracy is 81-87% in these languages (see Table 15 ). These results also show why automated rationale evaluation benefits from human validation, particularly when comparing judges with different linguistic capabilities. On wrong verdicts, the differences between the annotators and NLI are + 16.5 +16.5 points in SC (95% bootstrap CI 9.8 to 23.2) and − 12.4 -12.4 points in HA ( − 17.5 -17.5 to − 7.2 -7.2 ), so the NLI-based estimates in Table 17 are conservative. Unlike NLI (79.1% vs. 70.1%), the annotators find no SC gap between correct and wrong verdicts (84.7% vs. 86.6%). They choose “Can’t tell” for 7.7% of judge rationales, with notes pointing to ungrammatical generated text in Norwegian and Urdu, and rarely flag reasoning that contradicts the stated conclusion (1.8%).

blocks.en: We apply two masks to judge and human rationales. The first removes verdict tokens and lines, including labeled verdicts (“Evaluation: B”), standalone verdict lines, and verdict tokens after the final sentence. The reported results use an aggressive mask that additionally removes every sentence containing a preference or equality term, such as better , preferred , equally , or tie , using Google Translate for term translations. This can remove reasoning clues (“better sentence structure”) while retaining comparisons without flagged terms (“Response B is more natural”). Removing an opening verdict sentence can leave near-zero entailment for all hypotheses (see Figure 10 ).
blocks.zh: 我们用两个口罩来判断人的理由 第一种删除了判决符号和线条,包括标注的判决书(“评价:B”),独立的判决书线条,以及最终判决后的判决符号. 使用Google Translate来翻译名词。 这可以去除推理线索(“更好的句子结构”),同时保留不标注术语的比较(“反应B比较自然”)。 撤销初判判决可能使所有假设都接近零(见图10)。

blocks.en: Token removal barely changes scores. Across the six NLI languages, the aggressive mask changes 28.3% of rationales and leaves 6.5% shorter than three tokens, which we exclude. We compare original and masked scores on the retained rationales (SC 70.7% vs. 64.3%; see Table 20 ). The masked human reference is 71.1%; on wrong verdicts, masked SC and HA are 59.0% and 22.5%, respectively. The original and masked judge rankings by SC have a Spearman correlation of 0.84.

We average over pairs, then equally over languages, then over criteria. Family comparisons contrast within-family pairs with all other pairs after averaging each pair’s κ \kappa over languages and criteria.

blocks.en: Here, we present a shortened version of the guidelines for human evaluation of NLI verdict recovery.

blocks.en: We further show a snapshot of the interface we used (see § F.5 ).

blocks.en: I.1 Guidelines
blocks.zh: 一.1 准则

blocks.en: Objective Read a short rationale that compares two AI-generated responses to the same instruction, Response A and Response B, on one of the five criteria. You see only the rationale, not the instruction or the responses. Identify the preference the rationale expresses; do not decide whether its assessment is correct. Choosing an answer • A: The rationale prefers A, explicitly or through its reasoning, such as praising A or identifying a problem with B. • B: The rationale prefers B in the same way. • Tie: The rationale expresses equal quality or no meaningful difference; the responses can be equally good or equally bad. • “Can’t tell”: No preference or equality can be inferred: there is no comparison, the trade-offs are unresolved, or the text is too unclear or broken to interpret. Self-contradiction flag Tick the flag only when the rationale states a conclusion and its reasons clearly favor a different answer on the same criterion. Still select the stated conclusion as your answer. Leave the flag unchecked when the reasons are weak or incomplete, the preference is small, or the rationale weighs different strengths before reaching a conclusion. General rules 1. A stated conclusion takes priority. If the rationale says “Final verdict: B”, select B. 2. Without a stated conclusion, use the reasoning. “A contains a factual error; B has none” implies B. 3. Small preferences count. “Both are fine, but B is slightly clearer” means B, not Tie. 4. Different strengths do not mean Tie. “A is more detailed; B is more concise” gives no preference or equality; choose “Can’t tell”. 5. Follow the rationale. Do not replace its preference with your own, and do not fact-check its claims. General steps 1. Train. Complete seven English training checks and compare each response with the suggested answer. 2. Annotate. Work independently through two files of 50 rationales each. 3. Add a note. Report issues such as cut-off text or mixed languages. 4. Skip sensitive content. Choose “Can’t tell” and add a note if you prefer not to read a rationale.

Annotators see only the rationale, choose A, B, Tie, or “Can’t tell” for the preference it expresses, can flag reasoning that contradicts the stated conclusion, add an optional note, and go back to revise earlier answers.
